package: iOS 1.5 store bundle (Pavol: 'bundle into 1.5 so we release everything together') + orchestrator: Czech in the App Store, Advent nomination text, measurement plan

czech_language.finding: iTunes lookup (7 Nov): the App Store lists the app's language as English only.
czech_language.cause: The App Store reads languages from the bundle's .lproj folders. The app had only Base.lproj (developmentRegion en). CFBundleLocalizations has listed cs and en since July (#14); that alone does not count.
czech_language.fix: ios/App/App/cs.lproj/InfoPlist.strings and en.lproj/InfoPlist.strings (display name and location prompt per language), a PBXVariantGroup in the Resources phase, cs in knownRegions.
czech_language.side_effect: English-language devices now get the location prompt in English; before, it was Czech everywhere.
czech_language.verify_after_release: Once 1.5 is live: https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6792305024&country=cz, where languageCodesISO2A should include CS.

listing.release_notes: ios/App/fastlane/metadata/cs/release_notes.txt rewritten for 1.5 (the old text was the 1.3/1.4 one). Pavol, 7 Nov: the kromě clause read as if once-a-month notes were hidden; it only drops one-off dated exclusions on other days, so the clause is out of the notes
listing.description: ios/App/fastlane/metadata/cs/description.txt: opens with 'Kam na mši' (was the old name 'Bohoslužby'); adds tap-a-time actions, Moje kostely, filters, title feasts; 1488 characters
listing.unchanged: name, subtitle, keywords, promotional text, URLs
listing.screenshots: regenerated with e2e/store-shots.spec.ts (iPhone 6.9" and iPad 13", plus the Android phone shot); the old ones dated from 7 Oct (iPhone) and 23 Aug (iPad). The list shot shows the July holiday note because the fixture date is in July. Pavol, 7 Nov: the detail shot shows a church photo; it is St Vitus with its own Commons photo (registry 10001).

repo_fix: #77 committed node_modules as a symlink to itself, so every fresh checkout broke npm/npx. It is now untracked (it was already in .gitignore).
nomination: docs/store/nomination-advent-2026.md: New Content, 29 Nov – 6 Jan, English fields plus a Czech note, the App Store Connect path. Pavol submits it by 12 Nov.

measurement_plan.what: App Store impressions, product page views, first-time downloads (App Store Connect → Analytics → Acquisition), Czechia.
measurement_plan.windows: 29 Nov – 12 Dec 2026 against the baseline 1–14 Nov 2026; both are 14 days and start on a Sunday
measurement_plan.read_on: 13 Dec 2026 (App Store Analytics lags 24–48 h, so read again on 15 Dec)
measurement_plan.featuring_signal: an email from Apple, or a 'Featured' traffic source in App Store Analytics; also a spike in impressions with no change in web referrals
measurement_plan.confounders: Advent itself raises search for Mass times, so the season alone may lift the numbers. Compare with the web KPIs (page_view, conversion) over the same windows: a jump in the store that the web doesn't share points to featuring.
measurement_plan.who_reads: an agent can't read App Store Connect Analytics (no ASC session in the sandbox), so Pavol exports the two windows as CSV into docs/review/, or the hand-back asks him for the four numbers
measurement_plan.baseline_note: 1.4 has been live since 30 Oct with 3 ratings, so the numbers are small. A difference of a few downloads is noise.

release_steps: Pavol OKs the screenshots and text (this hand-back)
Release iOS, lane 'release' on main: uploads build 92 with the listing and screenshots; it never submits
Pavol: version 1.5 → attach build 92 → Submit for Review; then the nomination by 12 Nov
limits_kept: no store submission, no App Store Connect changes, no emails or posts, no Supabase SQL
